goal: Third-party packs pass conformance; custom events and node types stay catalogued
scenarios: the catalog lists built-in node types and system event types
importing a namespaced pack records its templates, custom events, custom nodes, and extension packages
conformance fails when a pack uses an unknown node type or an undeclared tool
a pack cannot be enabled for a project until conformance passes; conflicting extensions fail with an explicit conflict
custom events require a pack or project namespace and cannot redefine system events
custom nodes appear in the designer catalog only after conformance, and Test Lab simulates them from fixtures
customers cannot import packs or register custom events
constraints: issue tracker sync is out of scope
do not start Phase D chrome on the fused board cockpit
nonGoals: timeout and retry Test Lab scenarios
